name: slskd
description: slskd is a modern client-server application for the Soulseek file-sharing network with a web interface, API support and reverse-proxy compatibility.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Persistent slskd configuration, database, logs and application data. Must be writable by the configured container UID/GID.

paths.name: Completed Downloads
paths.description: Completed Soulseek downloads. This directory must be writable by the container user.

paths.name: Shared Music
paths.description: Music library shared through Soulseek. Read-only is recommended when slskd only needs to serve existing media.

ports.name: HTTP Web UI
ports.description: slskd HTTP web interface and API.

ports.name: HTTPS Web UI
ports.description: Optional slskd HTTPS interface using its built-in self-signed certificate.

ports.name: Soulseek
ports.description: Incoming Soulseek peer connections. Forward this port if incoming peer connectivity is required.

variables.name: Remote Configuration
variables.description: Allows configuration changes through the Web UI/API. Disable for untrusted or directly Internet-facing deployments.

variables.name: Downloads Directory
variables.description: Directory where completed downloads are stored.

variables.name: Shared Directory
variables.description: Directory shared through Soulseek. [Music] is the public share alias. Multiple shares can be separated with semicolons.

variables.name: File Umask
variables.description: Permissions mask for files created by slskd. 002 creates group-writable files and works well with shared MOS groups.

variables.name: API Key
variables.description: Optional primary API key for applications integrating with slskd. Use a strong secret of at least 16 characters.

variables.name: Soulseek Username
variables.description: Soulseek network username. Required to connect to the Soulseek network.
